feed.title: Greek News Aggregator — Daily Top Stories
feed.subtitle: Top headlines from kathimerini.gr

entry.title: Δένδιας για θαλάσσιο ουκρανικό drone: «Εξαιρετικά σοβαρό το ζήτημα»
entry.summary: Defence Minister Dendias called the Ukrainian Cossack-Mamai USV found off Lefkada 'extremely serious'. The kamikaze drone, designed for Black Sea strike missions, can reach 110-120 km/h. Ukrainian Defence Minister Fedorov pleaded ignorance and promised to investigate, raising fears the war is spilling into Mediterranean shipping lanes.

entry.title: Το Αιγαίο αφορά το νομοσχέδιο της Αγκυρας
entry.summary: Turkish academics from the DEHUKAM centre admitted that Ankara's draft 'maritime jurisdiction zones' bill is primarily aimed at the Aegean. They framed it as legal codification of the 'Blue Homeland' doctrine, although Turkish sources told Kathimerini the text will not contain maps or coordinates.

entry.title: Ο πλανήτης με το βλέμμα στο Πεκίνο: Τι επιδιώκουν Τραμπ και Σι
entry.summary: US President Trump and China's Xi meet in Beijing in a period of intense geopolitical turbulence. Trade, AI, Taiwan and Ukraine top the agenda — framed by both sides as a 'historic opportunity' to reset US-China economic relations.

entry.title: Παρενόχληση του «Ocean Link» από τουρκική πυραυλάκατο μεταξύ Κω και Αστυπάλαιας
entry.summary: A Turkish missile boat harassed the cable-laying vessel 'Ocean Link' via radio in international waters between Kos and Astypalaia. Greek frigate 'Adrias' intervened, asserting the ship was outside Turkish jurisdiction; Ankara continues to dispute waters east of the 25th meridian — part of a pattern of similar incidents.

entry.title: Λευκάδα: Τα επόμενα βήματα και η αντιγραφή του drone-καμικάζι
entry.summary: Senior Greek officers describe the Lefkada USV as 'a gift from heaven' — a complete kamikaze drone whose specs match a €12m ELKAK procurement program. Engineers are reverse-engineering the software and onboard control unit to leapfrog years of domestic R&D.

entry.title: Συμμαχικές υποχρεώσεις
entry.summary: Kathimerini's editorial argues that despite Greece's unwavering solidarity with Ukraine, Athens has a right not to be blindsided by covert military actions in or near its waters. The Lefkada drone breaches that minimum allied expectation.

entry.title: Δίκες – εξπρές για βουλευτές
entry.summary: The government is finalising legislation that would impose strict timelines on trials involving MPs and ministers: three months for misdemeanours and six months for felonies. The amendment may be tabled this week and is partly driven by the OPEKEPE-related cases — though it faces a constitutional-equality challenge.

entry.title: Η υπόθεση του drone στη Λευκάδα τέθηκε στον Ουκρανό ΥΠΑΜ
entry.summary: Greece formally raised the Lefkada Ukrainian drone case at the EU Defence Council in Brussels. Dendias warned of risks to dense Mediterranean shipping lanes; Ukrainian counterpart Fedorov said only that he would investigate. The Greek General Staff (GEETHA) is expected to complete its assessment within 24 hours.

entry.title: Κυπριακό: Σχέδιο για λύση πριν από το τέλος του έτους «βλέπει» ο Χριστοδουλίδης
entry.summary: Cypriot President Nikos Christodoulides said a UN Secretary-General initiative led by António Guterres could deliver a draft Cyprus settlement plan as early as end-2026 — a notably upbeat prediction on a decades-stalled diplomatic file.

entry.title: ΠΑΣΟΚ: Προτείνει εκλογή του Προέδρου με 180 ψήφους
entry.summary: PASOK proposes amending Article 32 of the Constitution so the President is elected by a three-fifths supermajority (180 MPs), with the incumbent's term extended until that threshold is met. The party also proposes constitutional protection against gender-based violence and a right to women's reproductive autonomy.

entry.title: Σε υψηλά 11 ετών το Χρηματιστήριο Σαγκάης – «Φρενίτιδα» AI πριν από τη σύνοδο Τραμπ–Σι
entry.summary: Shanghai stocks hit an 11-year high as investors piled into Chinese tech and AI names ahead of the Trump-Xi summit. The 'AI frenzy' frames the meeting as a potential turning point for US-China economic relations.

entry.title: Περιστέρι: Εξι ανήλικα παιδιά ζούσαν μέσα σε ακαθαρσίες – Συνελήφθησαν οι γονείς τους
entry.summary: Police in Peristeri arrested the parents of six children aged 3-11 after a report that the minors were living in filthy, neglected conditions. The children were transferred to Aghia Sophia children's hospital for medical evaluation.

entry.title: Σχοινάς – Πιτσιλής: Πάνω από 2,2 δισ. ευρώ σε 600.000 αγρότες – «Το πάρτι για τους επιτήδειους τελείωσε»
entry.summary: Agriculture Minister Margaritis Schoinas and AADE head Giorgos Pitsilis pledged €2.231 billion in payouts to 600,000 farmers by end-2026 as OPEKEPE merges into the tax authority. 'The party is over for the cheats,' said Schoinas, announcing a new sheep-and-goat traceability bill alongside the reform.

entry.title: Επιστροφή σε αξιολόγηση Α+ το 2031 με 2032 «βλέπει» η Fitch
entry.summary: Fitch reaffirmed Greece's BBB rating with a stable outlook and projected a possible return to its pre-crisis A+ rating by 2031-2032 — provided strong GDP growth and continued debt reduction. A milestone framing for the country's recovery arc.

entry.title: ΣΥΡΙΖΑ: Αίτημα για κλήση στην Επιτροπή Θεσμών του εισαγγελέα Κ. Τζαβέλλα και του διοικητή της ΕΥΠ
entry.summary: SYRIZA is demanding that Areios Pagos prosecutor Konstantinos Tzavellas and EYP director Themistoklis Demiris be summoned before parliament's Institutions Committee. The request follows the closure of the wiretapping case and Tzavellas' role in signing 11 Predator surveillance orders.

entry.title: Τι βρίσκεται στον πυρήνα της τεχνητής νοημοσύνης;
entry.summary: Nikos Konstantaras worries that AI is silently eroding human agency. As Christian leaders speak out in defence of human dignity, he calls for sharper attentiveness to the social and ethical costs of accelerating AI deployment.

entry.title: Κρίσιμο τεστ ενότητας για την ομάδα των BRICS
entry.summary: BRICS foreign ministers gather in New Delhi for two days starting Thursday, with the US-Israel-Iran conflict overshadowing the agenda and testing the bloc's ability to forge a unified position.

entry.title: Μεταναστευτικό: Επαλήθευση ταυτότητας και διαχωρισμός στα σύνορα
entry.summary: The Migration Ministry has submitted a draft bill implementing the new EU Migration and Asylum Pact, effective July. Key provisions include identity verification and screening at the border, plus a unified procedural framework for migration flows.

entry.title: Από την κόντρα ΗΠΑ – Κίνας στη συνεργασία για την AI
entry.summary: An analysis reframes US-China AI competition: America brings capital and chips, China brings engineering talent and manufacturing scale. Despite the rivalry, both must cooperate to prevent powerful AI from silently eroding human agency.

entry.title: Η παγκόσμια θύελλα και το ελληνικό πρόβλημα
entry.summary: Vasilis Nedos argues that New Democracy's seven-year dominance is fading — the classic life-cycle of any Greek party that has won two elections. Below ND, a crowded field is creating an unstable polling landscape.
